passenger_outcomes.name: Priya Raghunathan
passenger_outcomes.detail: Rebooked on flight AK845 from LHR to BCN and AK152 from LGW to BCN as options due to cancellation of flight AK412.
passenger_outcomes.reasoning: Flight AK412 was cancelled due to extraordinary weather circumstances, resulting in rebooking and duty of care provisions being applied.

duty_of_care_actions: GBP 60 paid for meals and communication costs due to flight cancellation.
uncertainties: Unable to issue hotel voucher as passenger already has confirmed rebooking.
passenger_reply_draft:
Hello Priya,

Your flight AK412 was unfortunately cancelled due to weather conditions. We've rebooked you on flight AK845 from Heathrow at 09:15, and as a backup, you are also booked on flight AK152 from Gatwick at 09:10. Additionally, we've issued a goodwill payment to cover your meals and communication expenses incurred during this disruption.

If you need any further assistance, please let us know.

Best regards,
Aerlink Customer Care.
